passiveEffect: Transform into Fire Dragon Slayer - Natsu, replacing your skill set while gaining Ability Conversion. Passive: Casting skills other than an Ultimate Skill grants stacks of Dragon Flame based on the skill type. Every 10 stacks of Dragon Flame automatically converts into 1 stack of Dragon Force. Dragon Force can stack up to 5 times. Each stack of Dragon Force grants a Fire Bonus. 1. Fire Dragon's Iron Fist: Charges briefly before unleashing a blazing punch forward, dealing Fire Attack DMG and accumulating 5 stacks of Dragon Flame. 2. Fire Dragon's Wing Attack: Leaps fiercely and dashes forward, dealing Fire Attack DMG and accumulating 5 stacks of Dragon Flame. 3. Fire Dragon's Roar: Gathers the power of flames to spew a massive blast of fire forward, dealing Fire Attack DMG. If at max Dragon Force stacks, consumes all stacks of Dragon Force to gain CD reduction for Natsu's skills and a Fire Bonus. This effect persists for the duration of the current transformation and can stack up to 3 times.
